text: ok cool. now iirc this does obj output and we have glb import but obj was added i think but not entirely? check
resolution: Checked OBJ vs GLB import support per user's recollection that OBJ was 'added but not entirely'. Confirmed: there are two import paths and both accept .obj, but neither consumes InstantMesh's baked texture. (1) tools/importPropMesh.mjs (genprop bake to placeable prop) has a fully-implemented parseObj -- reads v/vn/vt, full v/vt/vn face refs, n-gon fan-triangulation, negative indices, dispatched by extension at line 423, and even keeps UVs in the stride-8 vertex buffer. BUT it has ZERO mtl/texture/png/material handling (grep returns nothing); the prop is built with only a flat --color (default #9b8066, buildEntry line 476), so the parsed UVs are dead data. (2) editors/model/importMesh.ts (Studio import) parses positions+faces only, UV/normal/material intentionally discarded since Studio re-unwraps and paints fresh -- by design, not a gap. The real hole: InstantMesh --export_texmap emits obj+mtl+albedo.png, but the importer reads only the obj geometry and drops the mtl + texture PNG, so InstantMesh props arrive untextured/flat-colored, contradicting the props-uniform-capability ruling. No code changed (check/report task). Proposed fix relayed: parse mtl map_Kd, load the PNG via the @reactjit/image codec door, bake onto the prop as a textureKey/material using the already-parsed UVs. Awaiting user go-ahead to implement.
